SpeechContent.SourceString: 引航者，让我们开始吧，为了让更多人拥有选择未来的力量。
SpeechContent.LocalizedString: Navigator, let's embark on this journey, empowering more people to shape their future.

SpeechContent.SourceString: 新的学员加入了，希望他们能够战斗到最后。
SpeechContent.LocalizedString: New Cadets have joined the fray. Let's hope that they can fight to the very end.

SpeechContent.SourceString: 达成阶段目标，请签收新的支援物资。
SpeechContent.LocalizedString: To reach your phase objectives, make sure to check in and claim new items.

SpeechContent.SourceString: 从这里毕业的学员, 希望他们也能像你一样成为别人的榜样。
SpeechContent.LocalizedString: May the Cadets who graduate from here one day inspire others like you have.

SpeechContent.SourceString: 现在没有学员，需要我来物色一些吗
SpeechContent.LocalizedString: There aren't any Cadets right now. Shall I go out and find some?

SpeechContent.SourceString: 还能接纳新的学员，请量力而为。
SpeechContent.LocalizedString: We've got room for more Cadets. Please do your best.
